rust_toolchain.verification: Every native quality or package job reports or exercises cargo, rustc, and the selected host before accepting evidence.

action_provided.control: The full reviewed action commit is pinned in each workflow before brew is used. scripts/prepare-homebrew-runner.sh verifies brew and the declared readlink/rm commands before the GitHub-hosted macOS-only openssl@1.1 link normalization; it accepts one bounded normalized absolute brew prefix and removes only bin/openssl symlinks with the exact legacy opt target, then verifies absence. Installed-channel jobs preserve that script from the exact current runner-contract checkout before selecting a historical release tag.

container_provided.control: Compatibility commands run only inside digest-pinned images declared in tests/compatibility/matrix.json.

generated_environment.control: Ruby is used only by the generated Homebrew formula after setup-homebrew establishes the Homebrew environment.
